_provenance.source: NASA POWER climatology, parameter ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN (all-sky surface shortwave downward irradiance), community=AG, units MJ/m2/day, custom climatology years 2001-2020
_provenance.method: Regional climatology API fetched in 10x10-deg JSON tiles (native 1x1-deg solar grid); each 0.5x0.625-deg MERRA-2 cell mapped to its containing 1-deg solar cell (center = floor(coord)+0.5, matching the site's compiled December DLI); DLI = ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN x 0.45 x 4.57, rounded to 1 decimal (mol/m2/day)
